description: Count the frames in an SMPTE timecode from midnight. Rates are 24, 25 and 30. A colon is non-drop and a semicolon is drop-frame, which is only legal at 30. Drop-frame skips 00 and 01 at the start of each minute except every tenth minute, so 01:00:00;00 is frame 107892 rather than 108000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/timecode-frames
name: timecode_frames
title: Timecode Frames
